scene: A split-screen phone call in a still locked 16:9 frame. Left panel: the fruit market, where Child stands holding a phone to his ear beside a small shopping basket with one green apple inside. Right panel: the home garage, where Dad stands with the phone to his ear beside his tidy workbench. Each speaker stays in their own panel; no cuts between locations and no extra people.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Both speak at a normal family volume with small, natural facial movements and gestures.
emotion.allowed_shift: Child speaks with bright phone manners and small listening nods; Dad answers warmly with a smile in his voice; both end the call warmly.
emotion.forbidden: No exaggerated surprise, wide-eyed shock, bouncing, raised voices, impatience, blaming or teasing. Any disappointment, worry or sadness stays mild and brief, and the adult helps things stay steady.

clips.start: Left panel: Child stands by the basket holding the phone to his ear. Right panel: Dad stands by the workbench holding the phone to his ear.
clips.action: Child waves slightly at the phone while greeting Dad and naming the market; Dad leans comfortably against the workbench and asks his question; Child glances at the basket while answering.
clips.end: Both keep their phones at their ears; Child looks toward the milk shelf off-frame.

clips.start: Both keep their phones at their ears; Child looks toward the milk shelf off-frame.
clips.action: Child asks Mom's milk question while cupping his free hand by his mouth. Dad points once toward the fridge off-frame for the big blue bottle. Child looks down and pats the small basket, explaining it is too heavy.
clips.end: Both keep their phones at their ears; Child's free hand rests on the basket handle.

clips.start: Both keep their phones at their ears; Child's free hand rests on the basket handle.
clips.action: Dad counts two on his fingers for the small bottles; Child repeats with two fingers and asks his extra question. Dad says the warm closing line; Child waves a small goodbye at the phone and lowers it from his ear, smiling.
clips.end: Left panel: Child holds the lowered phone with both hands, smiling by the basket. Right panel: Dad lowers his phone with a warm smile beside the workbench.
